facts.summary: Pivotal trial missed primary and secondary endpoints, program suspended, 70% layoffs · Phase 3 · mavodelpar in primary mitochondrial myopathies · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the Company announced its pivotal STRIDE study (NCT04535609) of mavodelpar in adult patients with primary mitochondrial myopathies did not meet its primary efficacy or secondary efficacy endpoint
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: did not meet its primary efficacy or secondary efficacy endpoint
evidence.program_discontinued: suspension of the ongoing STRIDE AHEAD study and all other mavodelpar development activities and a workforce reduction of approximately 70%
